en.headline: Man found dead in Tai Wai flat after family loses contact
en.dek: Police received a report around 11pm on Thursday that a 35-year-old man had not been heard from; he was confirmed dead at the scene in Chun Shek Estate.
body: Police are investigating after a 35-year-old man was found dead at his home in Tai Wai on Thursday night. Family members contacted officers after losing touch with him and fearing he had collapsed inside the flat.

Officers received the report at about 11pm on 29 October concerning Shek Yuk House in Chun Shek Estate. Ambulance crews arrived and found the man, surnamed Lee, lying in the unit. He was certified dead at the scene.
The cause of death is pending a post-mortem examination. Police said the case remains under investigation, with no immediate indication of foul play reported in initial inquiries.
The estate is in the Sha Tin district. Authorities continue routine checks to establish the circumstances.

zh.headline: 大圍春石苑35歲男子在家中被發現死亡
zh.dek: 警方周四晚約11時接報家屬失去聯絡，救護人員到場後證實該名男子已死亡，死因有待驗屍確定。
body: 警方正調查一宗大圍住宅單位內發現男子死亡的案件。家屬因多日未能聯絡該名35歲男子而向警方求助，擔心他可能在單位內倒臥。
警方於10月29日晚上約11時接獲報案，指沙田大圍春石苑石旭樓有單位內有人可能倒地。救護人員到場後發現姓李的男子倒臥單位內，並即場證實他已經死亡。
死因有待法醫進行驗屍後才能確定。警方表示案件仍在調查中，初步未有發現可疑情況。
相關部門繼續跟進，以了解事發經過。
